definition.title: Get featured in the newsletters and communities your buyers read
definition.description: Finds newsletters and communities your buyers read that have a written way in, such as a featured-tool slot, reader submissions, a showcase thread or a sponsorship, verifies each one's rules, and drafts one submission per placement in your voice. Skips placements drafted in earlier runs; never submits, pays or contacts anyone.

focus.title: Who to reach (optional)
focus.description: Leave empty to use the buyers named in the growth plan and Feature map.

geography.title: Geography (optional)
geography.description: Leave empty to use the market in the growth plan.

budget_usd.title: Sponsorship budget per placement (USD)
budget_usd.description: 0 keeps the list to free placements. Paid slots above this are left out.

prerequisites.reason: The growth plan names the buyers, the market, the budget and the hard no's.
The Feature map supplies the real product detail each submission cites.
A captured writing style guide shapes the drafted submissions.
